system_configurations.name: RCCL-PerfSweep-1P4G
system_configurations.description: Single-node 4-GPU rccl-tests perf sweep (1KB-16GB): channel-count and unroll-factor sweeps per collective, plus symmetric-memory and SDMA variants. ReduceScatter runs last.

channel_sweep_base.description: Channel-count / unroll-factor sweep; saturates the P2P channel count so NCCL_MIN_P2P_NCHANNELS / NCCL_MAX_P2P_NCHANNELS take effect. RCCL_UNROLL_FACTOR is restricted to 3-5 (unroll 8/16/32): a local-GPU-only gfx1250 build generates device function tables for only those unrolls, and comm init rejects any factor whose table is missing. Factors above 2 additionally require a branch with gfx1250 unroll support, and are out of range without it.
